card.name: Just before a year is written
card.fires_on: The word 'in', a space, or a hyphen right before a four-digit year, especially after a date-setting verb or 'late'. The model expects the year digits to come next.

modes.label: 'in' before a year
modes.description: The word 'in' after an event verb, right before a year or decade.
modes.example: The Eagle first flew in July 1972, and entered service<< in>> 1976.

modes.label: Space before year digits
modes.description: A space or hyphen sitting just before the digits of a year or year range.

card.writes: It promotes number words like seventy, eighty and forty and suppresses digit tokens, so it pushes toward the tens words that start a year.
card.plain: It fires at the spot just before a year such as 1976 is written out.
